'''Northeastern Pomo''', also known as '''Salt Pomo''', is a [[Pomoan languages|Pomoan language]] of [[Northern California]]. There are no living fluent speakers. It was spoken along Stony Creek, a [[tributary]] of the [[Sacramento River]]. Northeastern was one of seven mutually unintelligible Pomoan languages spoken in Northern California. Unlike the other six Pomoan languages (going to north to south: Northern Pomo, Central Pomo, Eastern Pomo, Southeastern Pomo, Kashaya Pomo, Southern Pomo), Northeastern Pomo was not spoken in an area immediately contiguous with any other Pomoan-speaking area. Northeastern Pomo speakers were ringed by speakers of [[Yuki language|Yuki]], [[Nomlaki language|Nomlaki]], and [[Patwin language|Patwin]]; Yuki is unrelated to Pomoan or Nomlaki and Patwin, both of which are within the Wintu language family.
